product.tagline: 把市场判断、组合执行与复盘连成证据链。
product.description: 结合真实账户、持仓与市场数据，组织风险检查、组合计划、人工决策、纸面执行和结果归因。
nonGoals: 承诺投资收益或提供不可解释的黑盒买卖点
在无人值守状态下提交真实订单
缺少价格、账户、汇率、基准或日期对齐时放行风险增加动作

facts.label: 执行边界
facts.value: 不无人值守下真实订单

capabilities.title: 组合真值
capabilities.body: 管理账户、现金、持仓、交易和估值，对账单先预览、校验和去重再写入。

capabilities.title: 资产研究
capabilities.body: 从组合或 Profile 标的进入单资产视图，检查行情、技术结构、边界与执行路线。

capabilities.title: 组合决策
capabilities.body: 把概览、结构、回测、规则和指标放进可复核的证据视图。

capabilities.title: 量化回放
capabilities.body: 组合信号、仓位、退出、风险、执行和评估策略，运行纸面成交与晋级检查。

capabilities.title: 复盘归因
capabilities.body: 连接建议、委托、成交、日终估值和后续结果，保留完整审计链。

capabilities.title: 透明风险评分
capabilities.body: 按 Profile 计算可解释的风险维度、触发规则、价格线和历史检验。

workflow.label: 真值
workflow.title: 对齐账户与市场输入
workflow.body: 确认现金、持仓、价格、汇率、基准和日期处在同一估值口径。

workflow.label: 分析
workflow.title: 形成可解释的组合计划
workflow.body: 检查技术结构、风险规则、历史回测与仓位约束，不依赖黑盒信号。

workflow.label: 决策
workflow.title: 由人接受、拒绝或延期
workflow.body: 保留建议版本、信心、失效条件、复核日期与关联执行记录。

workflow.label: 复盘
workflow.title: 用结果推动策略晋级
workflow.body: 在数据完整时记录正式快照，并把结果归因回策略和建议。

boundary.title: 它是决策工作台，不是收益承诺
boundary.body: rPortfolio 用于风险监控、人工决策与执行参考。缺少价格、账户、汇率、基准或日期对齐时会阻断风险增加动作，也不会无人值守地下真实订单。

product.tagline: Connect market judgment, portfolio execution, and review into an evidence chain.
product.description: Combine account truth, holdings, and market data to organize risk checks, portfolio plans, human decisions, paper execution, and outcome attribution.
nonGoals: Promise investment returns or provide opaque buy and sell signals
Submit live orders without an actively supervising user
Allow risk-increasing actions when prices, accounts, FX, benchmarks, or dates are not aligned

capabilities.title: Portfolio truth
capabilities.body: Manage accounts, cash, holdings, trades, and valuations, with statement batches previewed, validated, and deduplicated before local writes.

capabilities.title: Asset research
capabilities.body: Open a single-asset view from portfolio or profile symbols to inspect market snapshots, technical structure, constraints, and execution paths.

capabilities.title: Portfolio decisions
capabilities.body: Bring overview, structure, backtests, rules, and metrics into one reviewable evidence surface.

capabilities.title: Quant replay
capabilities.body: Compose signal, sizing, scaling, exit, risk, execution, and evaluation policies for paper fills and promotion checks.

capabilities.title: Outcome attribution
capabilities.body: Connect recommendations, orders, fills, end-of-day valuations, and later outcomes in a complete audit trail.

capabilities.title: Transparent risk scoring
capabilities.body: Calculate explainable risk dimensions, triggered rules, price levels, and historical validation from a versioned profile.

workflow.label: Truth
workflow.title: Align account and market inputs
workflow.body: Confirm that cash, positions, prices, FX, benchmarks, and dates share one valuation basis.

workflow.label: Analyze
workflow.title: Build an explainable portfolio plan
workflow.body: Review technical structure, risk rules, historical backtests, and sizing constraints without relying on an opaque signal.

workflow.label: Decide
workflow.title: Accept, reject, or defer as a human
workflow.body: Preserve the recommendation version, confidence, invalidation conditions, review date, and linked execution records.

workflow.label: Review
workflow.title: Use outcomes to promote strategies
workflow.body: Record formal snapshots only when data is complete, then attribute outcomes back to the strategy and recommendation.

boundary.title: A decision workbench, not a return promise
boundary.body: rPortfolio supports risk monitoring, human decisions, and execution reference. It blocks risk-increasing actions when prices, accounts, FX, benchmarks, or dates are misaligned, and it does not place unattended live orders.
